title: Military Service Hold Extensions: Payment Cut
content:
**Decision table — Hardship and Protective Holds.** The payment cut of a service extension of a Military Service Hold depends on the servicemember's net voluntary payments on the held account in the last six months, read from the account's money history under Placed Consumer Accounts: payments posted less payments returned, each dated less than six whole months before today, whole months being the difference in calendar months between the date and today, less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the date's day of the month. The cut is subtracted once from the days the service extension adds.

| Net voluntary payments in the period | Payment cut |
|---|---|
| At least the steady-payer amount of $300.00 | 30 calendar days (steady-payer days) |
| Above zero but below $300.00 | 15 calendar days (part-payer days) |
| None (zero or less) | Nothing |

## Both sides

| Net payments | Cut |
|---|---|
| $300.00 | 30 days |
| $299.99 | 15 days |
| $0.01 | 15 days |
| $0.00 | Nothing |

**Example (hypothetical).** Today is 15 September. Payments of $200.00 dated 20 March and $150.00 dated 1 August were posted; the $150.00 payment was returned on 9 August. The 20 March payment is 5 whole months old (6 calendar months, less one because 15 is smaller than 20), so it counts. Net payments: $200.00 plus $150.00 less $150.00, that is $200.00 — above zero, below $300.00: 15 calendar days are cut.
